chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abi Ayyub, from Humran, from one of the two of them, peace be upon them, who said:
A father is not subjected to retaliation for his child, while the child is killed in retaliation for his father if he kills his father deliberately.

key_terms.بِوَلَدِهِ: for his child, in the context of retaliatory killing
key_terms.وَالِدٌ: a father or parent in the legal sense mentioned here
key_terms.يُقَادُ: to be subjected to legal retaliation (qisas)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on qisas between a parent and child in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding retaliatory killing in cases involving a parent and child. It distinguishes between the ruling for a father who kills his child and a child who intentionally kills his father, establishing the latter as liable to qisas.
